SELECT DISTINCT vat_rate
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND channel_code = 'ST'
ORDER BY vat_rate

SELECT 
  vat_rate,
  SUM(gross_amount - net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate

SELECT 
  vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_net,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gross,
  SUM(gross_amount - net_amount) AS vat_charged,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - net_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(net_amount), 0), 4) AS avg_vat_rate_check
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate

SELECT 
  ROUND(vat_rate * 100, 2) AS vat_rate_percent,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate

SELECT DISTINCT dp.vat_class
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
ORDER BY dp.vat_class

SELECT 
  f.vat_rate,
  dp.vat_class,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_amt,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as gross_amt
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate, dp.vat_class
ORDER BY f.vat_rate, dp.vat_class

-- Calculate VAT with correction for the 25.5% rate which should be 24% based on vat_class
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN f.vat_rate = 0.2550 THEN 0.24
    ELSE f.vat_rate
  END AS vat_rate_corrected,
  ROUND(SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN f.vat_rate = 0.2550 THEN f.net_amount * 0.24
      ELSE f.gross_amount - f.net_amount
    END
  ), 2) AS vat_charged_corrected
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY vat_rate_corrected
ORDER BY vat_rate_corrected
